test_title: SSC CGL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 2 March 2023)
subject: general
question: Which among the following statements is incorrect?

options.text: Cache memory keeps the programs that can be run in a short amount of time.
Cache memory stores data in permanent use.
Cache memory is faster than main memory.
The size of cache is usually small.

solution:
Cache memory:

A cache is a temporary storage area that is more accessible to the processor than the computer's primary memory source. It is also known as CPU memory because it is often incorporated directly into the CPU chip or placed on a separate chip with a bus interface to the CPU. The cache stores data or commands related to CPU on a temporary basis.

RAM:

The RAM refers to the fact that the processor may directly access any storage location.

There are many primary memories are, 

__
 
• Dynamic RAM,
 
• Static RAM,
 
• Double Data Rate SDRAM,
 
• Double Data Rate 4 Synchronous Dynamic RAM,
 
• Rambus Dynamic RAM,
 
• Read-only memory,
 
• Programmable ROM,
 
• Erasable PROM,
 
• Electrically erasable PROM, and
 
• Virtual memory.

Hence the correct answer is true.
